Daylight (Day3 Evoc): Touched object radiates bright light in a 60' radius for 200 min

Endure Elements (Day1 Abju): Touched remains comfortable between -50F and 140F for 24 hr

Fire Shield (Day4 Evoc): Envelopes self in cold or hot flames that inflict 1d6+15 HP cold or fire on melee attackers (SR may negate) and reduce heat or cold damage taken by half, or negate it entirely with a successful allowed Reflex save, for 20 rd
Flame Strike (Day5 Evoc): R300' 10' radius, 40' high cylinder inflicts 15d6 HP (save Reflex half), half fire and half divine power
Planar Binding (Daemon6 Conj): Traps 1-3 extraplanar creatures with up to 12 HD total in a Magic Circle (save Will negates) until they perform a task (opposed Charisma allows refusal), or escape via SR, dimensional travel, or a DC 27 Charisma check
Prismatic Sphere (Day9 Abju): 10' radius sphere lasting 200 min blinds for 2d4x10 min creatures with up to 7 HD who look at it from within 20', blocks magical and nonmagical ranged attacks, poisons, gasses, petrification, breath weapons, divination, mental attacks, spells, objects, and effects, and inflicts on creatures other than self who pass through all of these effects: 20 HP fire (save Reflex half); 40 HP acid (save Reflex half); 80 HP electricity (save Reflex half); slain by poison (save Fortitude inflicts 1 point of Constitution damage per rd for 6 rd; 2 consecutive Fortitude saves ends); turned to stone (save Fortitude negates); insanity (save Will negates); sent to another plane (save will negates)
Summon Monster IX (Daemon9 Conj): R75' Summons 1 9th-level, 1d3 8th-level, or 1d4+1 lower-level creatures that fight foes and obey orders for 20 rd
Sunbeam (Day7 Evoc): 60' beam of light inflicts blinded and 4d6 HP (or 8d6 HP to creatures sensitive to sunlight and 20d6 HP to undead and oozes, destroying undead and oozes with a weakness to bright light) (save Reflex half HP only) once per rd 6 times within 20 rd
Sunburst (Day8 Evoc): R1200' 80' radius inflicts blinded and 6d6 HP (or 12d6 HP to creatures sensitive to sunlight and 20d6 HP to undead and oozes, destroying undead and oozes with a weakness to bright light) (save Reflex half HP only)
Unholy Aura (Daemon8 Abju): 20 creatures within 20' inflict -1d6 Strength on successful good attackers (save Fortitude negates) and gain a +4 deflection bonus to Armor Class, +4 saves, SR 25 vs. good spells and casters, an additional +2 save to suppress existing mental control and possession, and immunity to new attempts to control or possess, for 20 rd
Unholy Blight (Daemon4 Evoc): R300' Good creatures in a 20' radius suffer 5d8 HP (or 10d6 HP to outsiders) and are sickened for 1d4 rd (save Will half HP only); neutral creatures suffer half HP only (save Will half)
